about.title: about
about.description: Desktop AI meeting assistant. Real-time transcription via Deepgram, Google, OpenAI Whisper, ElevenLabs or local Whisper; answers via Vercel AI Gateway, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Groq or local Ollama. Sessions stored locally.
about.updates_hint: Zanban updates itself in the background. Check manually any time.
about.diagnostics_hint: Logs and environment info for troubleshooting and bug reports.

providers.ai_section_hint: Pick which provider answers your questions. Click a card to make it active — credentials stay in the OS keychain.
providers.privacy_mode_on: Active — LLM is Ollama, STT is local Whisper. Nothing leaves your machine.
providers.privacy_mode_off: Off — flips LLM + STT to local at once. Slower, lower quality, fully private.
providers.local_whisper_note: On-device — no key needed. Whisper-tiny via @xenova/transformers (~70 MB on first use).
providers.fallback_hint: When the active provider fails before streaming any text, Zanban tries these in order. Skipped silently if the credential is missing. Once an answer starts streaming we don't switch.
providers.fallback_empty: no fallbacks · errors will surface as-is
providers.tavily_hint: Powers live web search for company research. If empty, LLM general knowledge is used and may be outdated.
providers.tavily_auto_hint: Inject Tavily results into prompts ≥4 words.

vercel-gateway.name: Vercel AI Gateway
vercel-gateway.description: One key, every model — DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Groq. Pay-as-you-go.

anthropic.name: Anthropic Claude
anthropic.description: Direct Anthropic API. Best long-context reasoning.

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.description: GPT-5, GPT-OSS, o-series. Vision via the same model IDs.

google-gemini.name: Google Gemini
google-gemini.description: Gemini 2.5 / 3.x. Strong multimodal. Generous free tier.

groq.name: Groq
groq.description: Fastest TTFT (sub-100ms). Great for question detector.

ollama.name: Ollama (local)
ollama.description: Fully local — your transcripts never leave the machine.

deepgram.name: Deepgram Nova-3
deepgram.description: High-accuracy streaming. Single API key, low latency.

google.description: Chirp 3 multilingual streaming. Needs a GCP project + ADC or service account.

openai-whisper.name: OpenAI Whisper
openai-whisper.description: gpt-4o-transcribe via the OpenAI Realtime API. Streaming, low latency.

elevenlabs.name: ElevenLabs Scribe
elevenlabs.description: Scribe v2 Realtime — streaming WebSocket, ~150ms latency.

local-whisper.name: Local Whisper
local-whisper.description: On-device — no key needed. Whisper-tiny via @xenova/transformers.

general.appearance_hint: How the overlay sits on your screen during a call.
general.language_hint: Pick the interface language. The assistant's answer language is set separately under Identity.
general.privacy_hint: How the floating widget behaves around screen-sharing and Hide.
general.stealth_hint: On (default): the overlay is invisible to screen-share and recording. Off: shows up like any normal window.
general.hide_widget_hint: When you toggle Hide, also collapse the chips/input so only the tiny status pill remains.
general.hide_app_switcher_hint: Drop Zanban from the dock + Cmd+Tab on macOS, and the taskbar + Alt+Tab on Windows. Restart on macOS for the dock change to take effect.

general.transcript_window_hint: Seconds of recent audio sent as context for each Ask.

ai.models_card_hint: What model handles each task. Selector lists only the active provider's catalogue — no more `openai/gpt-oss-120b` showing up while talking to Anthropic.
ai.web_search_hint: External knowledge for company research. Uses Tavily; falls back to LLM general knowledge if no key.
ai.answers_hint: Length and verbosity of streamed text answers.
ai.detailed_answers_hint: Raise the output limit so answers truncate less often. Slightly slower. Off by default for short, snappy replies.
ai.streaming_hint: Ask hotkey, Answer last, and any text question. Pick the lowest-latency model you trust — this is what the user feels.
ai.question_detector_hint: Cheap classifier that scans the other speaker's transcript and decides 'is this a question?' Runs constantly — keep it cheap and fast.
ai.session_title_hint: Generates a short title at the end of a recorded call. Quality matters more than latency.

audio.capture_hint: Microphone for your voice. System loopback captures the other speaker.

audio.vad_hint: Drop pure-silence batches from the MIC channel before sending to STT. Saves bandwidth on quiet sessions. Never applied to system audio (the other speaker's loopback is left alone). Takes effect on next session start.
audio.stt_hint: How Zanban transcribes mic + system audio. Click a card to make it active — credentials stay in the OS keychain.

onboarding.title: First-run setup

language.title: Welcome to Zanban
language.body: A stealth meeting copilot that listens to mic + system audio, transcribes locally, and answers questions for you. Everything is on your machine — API calls only when you ask the LLM.

provider.title: Pick an LLM provider
provider.body: You can switch later in Settings. Cloud providers stream answers faster; Ollama keeps everything on your machine.

vercel-gateway.label: Vercel AI Gateway
vercel-gateway.blurb: Single key fans out to OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Groq. Recommended for most users.

anthropic.label: Anthropic Claude
anthropic.blurb: Direct Claude API. Strong reasoning, good at structured replies.

openai.label: OpenAI
openai.blurb: Direct OpenAI API. Vision-ready out of the box.

google-gemini.label: Google Gemini
google-gemini.blurb: Direct Google AI API. Long context windows, fast multimodal.

groq.label: Groq
groq.blurb: Lightning-fast inference. Lower per-token cost, smaller model menu.

ollama.label: Ollama (local)
ollama.blurb: Fully on-device. No API key needed — point at your local Ollama install.

deepgram.label: Deepgram

local-whisper.label: Local Whisper

google_service_account.hint: Paste a service-account JSON key for one-step auth. Leave blank if you've already run gcloud auth application-default login on this machine.

stt_fields.google_setup_help_title: How to set up Google STT
stt_fields.google_setup_help_body:
1. Open console.cloud.google.com → create or pick a project; copy its ID into the field above.
2. In the project: APIs & Services → enable “Cloud Speech-to-Text API”.
3. Auth — pick one:
   • Easiest: install the gcloud CLI, run gcloud auth application-default login once. Leave the JSON field blank.
   • Or: IAM → Service Accounts → create one with “Cloud Speech Client” role → keys → create JSON → paste contents into the field above.
stt_fields.local_whisper_note: No keys needed. The model downloads on first session and runs entirely on this machine.

hotkeys.title: Hotkeys
hotkeys.body: The five keys that matter most. All of them are global — they fire even when another app has focus. Customize them later in Settings → Hotkeys.

done.title: You're set
done.body: Hit <0>Start session</0> in the dashboard header to begin recording. The overlay floats on top of your call and is invisible to screen-share by default. Stop by Settings any time to swap providers, edit hotkeys, or re-run this wizard.

persona.title: What do you do?
persona.body: Pick a role so the assistant answers in the right voice. You can change or fine-tune this later in Settings.
